steps.speaker: Pemberton
steps.title: Your Shop
steps.body:
I'm Pemberton, your shop assistant. You run this place — I handle the shelves and the customers.

The town's crafters make the goods: the Blacksmith, Huntsman, Enchanter, Alchemist, and Chef. Tell me where to go and I'll pick up what they've got.

steps.speaker: Pemberton
steps.title: Stocking the Shelves
steps.body:
Tell me which crafters to visit and how many items to grab from each. I'll head out and bring back what I can — but what's available depends on what recipes they've unlocked and the quality of their workshop.

A Tier 1 blacksmith only has Common gear — basic anvils and worn hammers. Upgrade their facilities and they'll have the proper tools to produce Uncommon and Rare work.

steps.speaker: Pemberton
steps.title: More Recipes, More Variety
steps.body:
The more recipes a crafter knows, the wider my selection when I visit. Unlock new recipes at the Blacksmith, Huntsman, or Enchanter, and I'll have more to choose from next time I stock the shelves.

Upgrade the shop itself to give me room for more items on the shelves.

steps.speaker: Pemberton
steps.title: Restocking
steps.body:
Don't like what I brought back? Send me out again with a Refresh — costs a bit of gold, and I can only make so many trips based on how upgraded the shop is.

Or hit Re-allocate to change which crafters I visit entirely. Either way, I'll bring back a fresh batch.
